summary: Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (auth with Bearer tokens/refresh/register, demo, properties, bench, fixit, watch, directory, AI diagnose (gpt-5.4 ok:true), the whole issue flow request->booked->outcome->undo, contractors CRUD, AI extract + import + undo). Frontend at 390x844: landing, login, Fix-it list, Find help -> issue screen, AI drafted request sheet, Copy text + Undo toast, Booked sheet with day/time chips -> Scheduled, How did it go -> Resolved, Rentals tiles + Reset demo confirm, Bench chips/pin+undo/status sheet/+Add contractor, gap 'Add contractor' prefill, Snap Describe-it -> AI diagnosis + directory Save to bench + Track -> issue, register, wrong-password error and session kept after reload all WORK. CRITICAL: Logout is broken. The app goes blank with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (infinite redirect). Fixed a 'Unexpected text node' console error in Sheet/ConfirmSheet/EmptyState/ScreenHeader. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: 'changes' comes back as [] when the booked contractor's rank and score don't change (for example Mike's Plumbing at 98, 4 stars). The UI then shows no 'Bench updated' card. This is how the original site works, but users get no ranking feedback.
Always sample San Francisco listings, even for a Tahoe Cabin or Oakland issue (header says 'near San Francisco'). This is sample data by design.
Contractors saved from the directory (for example Fog City Plumbing) are not demo-flagged, so they survive a demo reset.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping logout shows a blank screen with 'Maximum update depth exceeded' (seen in the web console and expo.out.log). RCA: app/index.tsx (landing) and app/(tabs)/index.tsx both resolve to '/'. app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:19 does `<Redirect href="/" />` when user===false, which resolves back into the (tabs) group. That redirects again and loops forever. Fix: point the redirect at an unambiguous route (move the landing page to its own route such as /welcome, or rename the tabs index route) and/or call router.replace to the landing inside logout().

The toast sits on top of the header (y 8-72) for up to 10s and fully covers the back button and the logout button. The toast's Undo button lands where logout is, so a user who taps logout right after an action triggers Undo instead (reproduced: a newly added contractor got removed). Move the toast to the bottom above the tab bar, or offset it below the header.

issues: The 'Load demo data' button label is cut off to 'Load demo d...' at 390px when shown next to 'Reset demo'. Use a shorter label or let the buttons wrap/stack.
Many header-logout-button elements are mounted at once (one per tab), so there are duplicate testIDs.

react_native_issues.issue: `{sub && <T/>}` with sub="" put an empty text node inside a View, which caused the 'Unexpected text node' console error when RequestSheet closed. FIXED by switching to !! in src/ui.tsx:136,192,212,230 and src/components/ScreenHeader.tsx:25,27

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the logout infinite redirect. The landing route (app/index.tsx) and the tabs index route (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) both map to '/'; make the redirect in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:19 point at an unambiguous landing route.
HIGH: Move the toast so it doesn't cover the header back/logout buttons (bottom placement or top offset below the header).
Shorten or wrap the 'Load demo data' button label on Rentals.
Optional: show a 'Bench updated: no rank change' note when outcome changes are empty.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is 747 lines (>700); consider splitting the auth and issues routes into modules.
app/_layout.tsx calls LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true), which hides real errors during development.
DirectoryCard save(): service_area is hard-coded to 'San Francisco' plus the host's cities.
seed_data_creation: Registered test_*@example.com users (TEST_ prefix). Demo data for host@bullpup.example.com was reset after testing; the directory-saved 'Fog City Plumbing' contractor may still be there.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: export $(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) && pytest /app/backend/tests -v (pytest.ini forces -n 2; use -n 0 for serial). Tab testIDs: tab-index/tab-snap/tab-bench/tab-properties. Use '[data-testid="header-logout-button"]:visible' (duplicates exist). Fix-it action testIDs are fixit-action-{issue|outcome|gap|stale|watch}-{id}. Directory save button: [data-testid^=dir-][data-testid$=-save]; the rank-1 card is expanded by default, so tapping its toggle collapses it. Booking sheet confirm: booking-sheet-confirm-button. Outcome form: outcome-form-showed-yes / -ontime-yes / -star-N / -submit.
rca_of_issue: Logout: ScreenHeader.logout() -> setUser(false) -> TabsLayout renders <Redirect href='/'> -> '/' resolves to (tabs)/index inside the same group -> TabsLayout renders Redirect again -> 'Maximum update depth exceeded' and a blank screen. Reproduce: log in, tap the logout icon on the Fix-it tab.
